verdicts.why: Magneto confronts Xavier, Logan and Storm outside the Grey house; at Alcatraz Storm makes fog at Logan's request so Magneto cannot find the X-Men before Logan and Hank strike. Opposing sides with a direct act against him; enemy fits.

Xavier sends Storm and Logan to Alkali Lake because he senses trouble; they find Scott's glasses and Jean, but Scott and Storm never share a scene or exchange in The Last Stand. No dealing, so no stage.
On the bus Betty says Peter's new glasses look good on him; at Newark she and Ned tell him they ended their relationship. Text and cards are accurate.
Flash taunts Peter on the plane for being poor, grabs and wears the E.D.I.T.H. glasses on the bus, and Peter accidentally knocks him out getting them back.
Harrington announces the four-hour opera in place of the carnival and Flash answers him that none of them ever wanted to go to the opera.
MJ and Ned tell the teachers and class Peter is staying with family in Berlin; in London they break away together to draw Mysterio from the class and fight the drones in the Tower of London.
Harrington breaks up the plane seating ('MJ, stand up... MJ, you take my spot'), which leaves MJ next to Brad.
At the Prague carnival Ned invents 'Night Monkey', a European knock-off, to cover for Peter in the stealth suit; later he tells the chaperones Peter is visiting family in Berlin.
When Harrington announces the opera, Ned voices approval and Harrington thanks him.
Harrington takes Peter to sit beside him on the plane and tells him about his wife faking her blip; on the bus he orders Peter to sit down while Peter is stopping the drone.
In London Flash follows Ned, MJ and Betty when they break from the group, and they hide together with Happy in the Tower of London; rival stays the through-line.

The real Maria Hill never appears in Far From Home: the Hill on screen is Soren throughout, revealed in the film's own post-credits scene, and Fandom lists Hill there only as mentioned. The rules settle stages, not appearance lists; by analogy with the same-person rule the impostor is not Hill, so dropping Far From Home from Hill's appearances (and giving no Hill stages there) looks right.

Groot is on the Milano when the three threaten the Eclector for Quill and Gamora, then goes with the Guardians to plan the attack with Yondu and his men on the Eclector and fights on their side at Xandar.
On the Dark Aster Nebula stops Groot, Quill, Drax and Gamora as Groot lights the way, cursing Gamora, until Drax shoots her. She acts against the group Groot is in; enemy fits before Vol. 2.

value.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
value.text: Rocket threatens to blow up the Ravagers' ship until Quill tells him they have already struck a deal. Over Xandar, Kraglin blasts a hole in Ronan's ship while Rocket fires beside him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A bounty hunter who threatens the Ravagers' ship, then fights beside Kraglin over Xandar.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Yondu's first mate, who blasts open Ronan's ship beside Rocket.

verdicts.why: They do fight side by side over Xandar (Kraglin makes the hole, then joins Rocket against the Necrocraft), but Quill had already come to terms with the Ravagers before Rocket's threat; the text had the deal coming after it.
Mid-credits scene set in 2018: Steve, Natasha, Bruce and Rhodes monitor Fury's pager together at the compound until Carol appears. Credits scenes belong to their film.
Mid-credits scene: Natasha is among the Avengers monitoring the pager when Carol appears asking where Fury is. Cards point at the right people.
Mid-credits scene: Bruce is with the Avengers monitoring the pager when Carol appears asking for Fury. Bruce's card describes Carol and Carol's card describes Bruce, as required.
Mid-credits scene: Rhodes and Natasha monitor Fury's pager together at the compound.
Mid-credits scene: Rhodes and Steve are together at the compound trying to learn who Fury's pager reached.
Mid-credits scene: Natasha and Steve are together at the compound working out who Fury's pager reached.
Fury goes with Carol, Maria and Talos to Mar-Vell's lab, where G'iah is reunited with Talos, and escapes with the refugees; the refugees then share a meal with their rescuers at the Rambeau home.

Post-credits scene: Steve and Sam have Bucky in custody; unable to contact Tony because of the Accords, Sam says he knows someone who can help. Credits scenes belong to their film; ally matches the through-line into Civil War.
Post-credits scene: Steve and Sam hold Bucky; Steve says they cannot go to Tony because of the Accords. Friend stays the through-line.
Post-credits scene: Steve and Sam talk over the captured Bucky; Steve fears they are on their own and Sam says he knows a guy.
Ant-Man's 1989 Triskelion scene: Pym resigns before Howard, Peggy and Carson as S.H.I.E.L.D.'s leadership, and Howard tries to persuade him to stay.

bucky-barnes|sam-wilson.title: Ant-Man
bucky-barnes|sam-wilson.text: Sam Wilson and Steve Rogers have Bucky Barnes in their custody. Unable to turn to Tony Stark because of the Accords, Sam says he knows someone who can help.
bucky-barnes|sam-wilson.on_a_card_about_b: Holds Bucky in custody with Steve, and knows someone who can help.
bucky-barnes|sam-wilson.on_b_card_about_a: Held in custody by Sam and Steve, who can't turn to Tony.

bucky-barnes|steve-rogers.title: Ant-Man
bucky-barnes|steve-rogers.text: Steve Rogers finally has Bucky Barnes, holding him in custody with Sam Wilson. Unable to turn to Tony Stark because of the Accords, Steve fears they are on their own.
bucky-barnes|steve-rogers.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend. Holds him in custody, unable to turn to Tony.
bucky-barnes|steve-rogers.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend, finally found and held in custody.

verdicts.why: Owner settled that credits scenes belong to their film, and the Ant-Man post-credits scene shows Steve and Sam holding Bucky, so the Ant-Man stages stand. Value gives the two stages (as in items 22 and 23).
Burch ties up Dave, Kurt and Luis at the X-Con office; Dave and Kurt later arrive at Pier 39 together and taser Burch's men.
Burch ties up Dave and Luis with Kurt and injects Luis with truth serum; at the pier Dave and Kurt taser the men holding Luis at gunpoint.
Dave works at X-Con with Scott, helps when Scott brings Hank and Hope to the office after Ghost steals the lab, and celebrates Karapetyan's offer with Scott, Luis and Kurt.
Kurt is with the crew at the X-Con office when Scott brings Hank and Hope there to hide after the lab is stolen.
Luis hides Hank, Hope and Scott at X-Con, teasing Hank ('in your hour of need you would turn to us' / 'Not me.'), and later drives Scott, Hope, Hank and Janet away from the docks.

value.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
value.text: Paxton hugs Scott and tells him he is proud of him. He joins the family hug when Scott's house arrest ends.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Cassie's father, whom Paxton hugs and tells he is proud of.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Cassie's stepfather, who tells Scott he is proud of him.

verdicts.why: The hug, the 'I'm proud of you, bud' line and the group hug at the end are right, but calming Maggie during the FBI search is between Paxton and Maggie, not Paxton and Scott; dropped that clause. Cards unchanged.
Burch ties up Kurt beside Luis and drugs Luis; at the pier Kurt and Dave taser the men holding Luis at gunpoint.
Kurt works at X-Con with Scott, is with the crew when Scott brings Hank and Hope to hide at the office, and celebrates Karapetyan's offer with him.
